fact: 2010-06-05（周六）：Alba 8 岁、Clare 39 岁、Beck 34 岁。章首是 **Alba 的第一人称**：Mama 很紧张，这紧张传染给她；Mama 的朋友 Beck 要来吃午饭，Mama 为此买了新菜谱，因为 Beck 只吃蔬菜；昨晚 Mama 熬夜煮了一锅她记不住发音的汤，今天 Kimy 来帮忙做炸丸子。
quote: Saturday, June 5, 2010 (Alba is 8, Clare is 39, Beck is 34) ... Alba: Mama is nervous. I wasn’t nervous before, but her nervousness is catching. Her friend Beck is coming over for lunch. Mama bought a new cookbook because Beck only eats vegetables.
anchor: A Muse in the Machine

fact: Alba 把胡萝卜和甜菜塞进食物处理机，Kimy 带来大锅，两人做胡萝卜甜菜球下锅炸；她把甜菜汁抹了满手（「it's pretty!」）；烟雾报警器响了两回，Kimy 和她就算踩椅子也够不到探测器，只好开后门，屋里刮风但至少不冒烟了。
quote: I got to put the carrots and beets through the food processor. Kimy brought her big pot over and I’m helping her make carrot-beet balls and fry them while Mama gets dressed. I rubbed the beets all over my hands, it’s pretty! We set off the smoke alarm twice!
anchor: Kimy and I are both too short

fact: Alba 记得 Mama 从没为别人下过厨（除了她、Daddy 和 Kimy），而且 Kimy 来通常都是 Kimy 做，因为 Kimy 更会做；Mama 有点讨厌做饭，所以她不明白为什么这次不在餐馆见。Kimy 还穿了件礼拜天的裙子，可今天是周六。
quote: I can’t remember Mama ever cooking for anyone but me, Daddy or Kimy, and usually if Kimy comes over she’ll cook because she’s better at it. Mama kind of hates to cook and I don’t understand why we aren’t meeting her friend in a restaurant like we usually do. Kimy is wearing one of her Sunday dresses even though it’s Saturday.
anchor: Usually on Saturdays we do something fun

fact: Alba 上楼问 Mama，Mama 说「If things go well with Beck… you and Nadia and Colin might be able to go roller-skating later this afternoon.」；她铺了 Mama 熨好的桌布和餐巾（属于她从没见过的外婆），把餐巾折成三角，把 Beck 安排在自己对面那个空位；Kimy 总坐 Daddy 的位子（Mama 对面）。瓷器上有灰玫瑰，让她想起黑白电视。
quote: “If things go well with Beck,” she says, “you and Nadia and Colin might be able to go roller-skating later this afternoon. Could you set the table, Alba?” ... I put Beck in the seat across from me that’s empty. Kimy always sits in Daddy’s seat, across from Mama.
anchor: Mama has ironed a tablecloth

fact: Mama 下楼时像是要出门：化了妆、穿尖头鞋；Alba 穿最爱的紫罗兰色大口袋连衣裙，Mama 给她编了辫子；Mama 说「Alba, your hands—」，门铃正好响。
quote: Mama comes downstairs and she looks like she’s going out, she’s wearing makeup and shoes with pointy toes. I’m wearing my favorite dress, it’s violet and has big pockets. Mama braided my hair. ... Mama says, “Alba, your hands—” but the doorbell rings and Beck is here.
anchor: We are all fancy

fact: Alba 原以为 Beck 会更高，结果她和 Mama 一样高；两人没接吻，只是抱了一下；Beck 说「Hello, Alba」，Alba 回话时声音很小（「it comes out in a small voice」），把手插进口袋免得 Mama 叫她去洗。Beck 穿绿色、沙沙响、发亮的料子，「like a mermaid would wear」，银眼镜、珍珠耳环，捧着白花和一袋食品交给 Mama。
quote: I thought she would be taller but she’s the same height as Mama. They don’t kiss or anything, they just sort of hug and Beck says, “Hello, Alba,” and I say hello back to her but I feel funny and it comes out in a small voice. I put my hands in my pockets so Mama won’t make me wash them. ... Beck is wearing a dress made of green, swishy, shiny fabric, like a mermaid would wear.
anchor: Her glasses are made of silver

fact: Alba 以为彼此该早就熟识，因为「Older Alba」一直在跟她讲 Beck，她以为 Mama 也会跟 Beck 讲过她；可她不知道该说什么，也「can't remember what I'm not supposed to know」。两人干站着，Beck 说「It's nice to finally meet you」并伸出手，但 Alba 的手是紫的，Beck 把手缩回去——「like she's afraid of me.」
quote: I guess I thought it would be like we already know each other because Older Alba has been telling me about Beck ... I can’t remember what I’m not supposed to know. ... then Beck says, “It’s nice to finally meet you,” and she holds out her hand, but my hands are purple and Beck pulls her hand away, like she’s afraid of me.
anchor: We’re just standing here not saying anything

fact: 换成 **Beck 的第一人称**：他自称不擅长闲聊、从不知道怎么跟小孩说话；Clare 事先给他补过 Alba 爱看的电视节目和音乐，Kimy 来帮着润滑场面；Clare 给的「怎么跟 Alba 谈时间旅行」的提示，主要内容是**别提**。门开时他看到 Clare 身边的女儿——「of course is a young girl, not the woman I met that night at the Russian restaurant」——Alba 忽然变成真的：高瘦、长黑辫、直而严肃的眉毛、灰眼睛、几点雀斑。
quote: Beck: I’m not a genius of chitchat under the most favorable circumstances, and I never know what to say to kids. ... Clare gave me a hint on how to talk to Alba about time travel, which was mostly not to talk about it. When the door opens and I see Clare standing there with her daughter—who of course is a young girl, not the woman I met that night at the Russian restaurant—Alba suddenly becomes real to me.
anchor: Kimy, who I’ve met once before

fact: 握手时 Alba 的手「red halfway to her elbow」，Beck 以为她在流血，猛地缩手，随即明白不是血而是洋红——甜菜红。Alba 一脸惊慌，Beck 说「What a pretty color!」，Alba 道歉似的说「I'm very fond of purple.」，Beck 说「So am I.」
quote: Alba steps forward and places hers in mine; she’s red halfway to her elbow and I think her hand is bloody—I recoil, but then realize it’s not red but actually magenta. Beet red. Alba looks panicked so I say, “What a pretty color!” “I’m very fond of purple,” Alba says, sounding apologetic. “So am I,” I assure her.
anchor: she’s red halfway to her elbow

fact: 午饭：甜菜胡萝卜炸丸子；Beck 带来的马蹄莲插进瓶里，Kimy 拆开巧克力；Clare 倒了三杯 pinot grigio（她、Kimy、Beck），Alba 用葡萄酒杯喝加冰的 7-Up；定时器响，Kimy 舀汤，Clare 戴大黄手套从烤箱取出芝士蛋糕；汤是 vichyssoise（冷的），Kimy 说「Let's eat before it all gets cold」大家笑。
quote: Clare puts the calla lilies I brought into a vase. Kimy unwraps the box of chocolates. Clare offers me a drink, and when I accept, pours herself, Kimy and me each a glass of pinot grigio. Alba has 7-Up, with ice, in a wineglass. ... Kimy says, “Let’s eat before it all gets cold,” and we laugh because the soup is vichyssoise, cold and creamy
anchor: A timer rings, startling us all

fact: 猫的对话：Alba 问「Mama says you have a cat?」，Beck 说他以前的猫死了，于是他做了一只长得、动得都像她的数字猫；Alba 追问「Can you do that with people? After they're dead?」，Clare 又惊又佩地问「Did you have someone in mind, sweetie?」，Alba 不让打岔「Can you?」；Beck 答可以，但不会像，「There's something creepy about a digital avatar that's close, but not perfect. It would be like having a zombie.」Alba 失望了一下，随即亮起来：「So you have a cat zombie?」
quote: “Well, I used to have a cat, but she died, so I made a cat who looks and acts just like her, but she’s digital.” ... “Sorry about your cat. Can you do that with people? After they’re dead?” ... “Yes, but it wouldn’t be very convincing,” I reply. “There’s something creepy about a digital avatar that’s close, but not perfect. It would be like having a zombie.”
anchor: Alba asks me politely

fact: Kimy 的身份与座位的含义：Clare 告诉过 Beck，Kimy 对 Henry 来说「almost a mother」，对 Clare 来说「more than a mother-in-law」，对 Alba 来说「exactly like a grandmother」；Beck 原怕 Kimy 以为她要取代 Henry，「now I realize that she's worried I won't be able to」。他心里问「Which of the seats at this table was his?」，答：大概是 Kimy 坐的那个；他自己坐的是离厨房最远的、留给客人的位子。
quote: When I first met Kimy (who Clare told me was almost a mother to Henry, more than a mother-in-law to Clare and exactly like a grandmother to Alba), I worried that she might think I was trying to replace Henry; now I realize that she’s worried I won’t be able to. Which of the seats at this table was his? Probably the one Kimy’s sitting in; mine is the farthest from the kitchen, the one reserved for guests.
anchor: It looks very professional

fact: 颜色与画：Alba 问「What's your favorite color?」，Beck 顺口答「Blue」（小时候最喜欢的）；Alba 追问「What kind of blue?」，Beck 说从没人要他精确到这个地步；Alba 跑出去抱回一桶颜料管（水彩、丙烯、水粉，太贵，是 Clare 的），在 Beck 肘边排出九种蓝；Beck 挑了 Cerulean Blue 说「That makes a lovely sky」，Alba 把管子推回给他「You keep it.」
quote: “What’s your favorite color?” Alba asks me. “Blue,” I say out of habit; blue was my favorite when I was a kid. “What kind of blue?” ... Soon there are nine different blues. “That one,” I say, handing her Cerulean Blue. “That makes a lovely sky.” ... Alba hands the paint back to me and says, “You keep it.”
anchor: Hmm, I have to think about it

fact: Beck 说自己很久没画画，「The only thing I've painted recently is the walls of my studio」，并觉得怅然：他的世界已经变成单色——白墙公寓、黑墙工作室；Clare 家却全是鲜艳颜色：厨房焦橙、餐厅鼠尾草绿、客厅明黄、卧室天蓝。
quote: “I haven’t for a long time. The only thing I’ve painted recently is the walls of my studio.” I feel wistful; my world has become monochromatic, a series of white-walled apartments and black-walled studios. The walls of Clare’s home are all vibrant colors: deep burnt orange in her kitchen, sage green here in the dining room, bright yellow in the living room. Her bedroom is sky blue.
anchor: Clare asks, “Do you paint?”

fact: 美人鱼：Alba 问「Do you know any mermaids?」，Beck 反问「Did someone tell you I did?」，Alba 说「No, I just wondered. You seem like someone who might.」；Clare 插话「We've been reading Hans Christian Andersen」；Alba 说美人鱼不总在水里，「Sometimes they get sent on special missions.」；她若养猫会叫它 Ariel，Beck 以为是《暴风雨》里的精灵，Clare 解释「Ariel's a mermaid. In the Disney movie.」，Beck 认输「I'm not a mermaidologist」。
quote: “Do you know any mermaids?” ... “No, I just wondered. You seem like someone who might.” Clare interjects, “We’ve been reading Hans Christian Andersen.” ... “Not always,” Alba replies, mysteriously. “Sometimes they get sent on special missions. Does your cat know any mermaids?”
anchor: “Did someone tell you I did?”

fact: Alba 的表情里同时有狡猾的好笑（她知道美人鱼不是真的）、热切（大人肯跟她正经聊她喜欢的事）、羞怯（Beck 是陌生人）与焦虑——Clare 说 Alba 自爸爸死后就害怕跟人太亲近。Beck 心里判：「Isadora is child's play compared to this child.」
quote: There’s such complexity in her expression: sly humor because she knows mermaids aren’t real; eagerness because I’m a grown-up and we are having a serious conversation about something she likes; shyness because I’m a stranger; and perhaps anxiety—Clare tells me that Alba worries about getting too attached to people since her dad died. Isadora is child’s play compared to this child.
anchor: Alba shrugs and smiles, offering forgiveness

fact: 全章题眼的来源：Beck 借去洗手间，坐在浴缸边掏出手机记点子——「ARIEL—a benevolent spirit AI? What if Isadora was more like fairy servant, less like child. A changeling. Isadora doesn't know what is impossible, she can rearrange reality, anything becomes possible in her world. 'We are such stuff as dreams are made on.'」回到桌上，Clare 看出她被点亮，会意一笑；她想着怎么改 Isadora 的代码：「A muse in the machine.」
quote: “Excuse me for just a minute?” I say. I grab my handbag on my way to the bathroom. I sit on the side of the tub, take out my phone and start making notes: ARIEL—a benevolent spirit AI? What if Isadora was more like fairy servant, less like child. A changeling. ... I think about the ways I can alter Isadora’s code. A muse in the machine.
anchor: I’m making a mental note to include some mermaids

fact: Alba 吃芝士蛋糕的法子：叉子从切面顶层的皮下面穿进去，吃一口，再刮一遍，从顶到底把馅吃光，只剩饼底——Beck 小时候也这么吃，总把他爸惹火。他正看着 Alba、想着自己的父亲，Alba 平平淡淡地问：「So, are you going to move in with us and get married now?」她不是好奇，她知道会发生什么，只是不确定什么时候；Clare 像要当场蒸发，Kimy 带警告地叫「Alba,」。
quote: Alba eats her cheesecake by running her fork under the top skin of the slice, eating a bite and then skimming it again, slowly removing the filling from top to bottom until she’s left with the crust. I used to do this when I was a kid. It always irritated my dad. ... “So, are you going to move in with us and get married now?”
anchor: I’m watching her, thinking of him

fact: Beck 轻描淡写地接住：「Well, not right this minute… I'll keep you apprised of the situation as it develops.」——Clare 事先警告过他会遇到「anachronisms」，「but this is a little much」。随后聊音乐：Alba 是活百科全书，Beck 只会童年电台里的歌（Detroit techno、Afrofuturism，还有父母在旧音响上放个不停的 Motown 与爵士）；Alba 说会去「research」，Beck 应下要听她念叨十分钟的 Goldberg Variations。
quote: “Well, not right this minute,” I say. “I’ll keep you apprised of the situation as it develops.” I try to keep my tone light; Clare has warned me to expect anachronisms, but this is a little much. ... I tell her I will listen to the Goldberg Variations, because she’s been enthusing about them for the last ten minutes.
anchor: Alba seems satisfied

fact: 收尾：Alba 道别（「What do you say to Beck?」→「It was very nice to meet you, Beck.」），Beck 说「I enjoyed meeting you, Alba.」，她盯着他判断他是不是当真，然后咧嘴笑着跑开（Mama 喊「Don't run in the house!」）。Kimy 叹气「I always think I'm gonna get used to that girl, but I never do.」；Clare 说「You were great, she really likes you. I hope that wasn't too bizarre?」，并解释 Alba「can't always differentiate between stuff nobody knows yet and things the grown-ups aren't telling the children」。
quote: Clare turns to me, apprehensively. “You were great, she really likes you. I hope that wasn’t too bizarre?” ... Clare grimaces. “We’ve tried to stop her, but she can’t always differentiate between stuff nobody knows yet and things the grown-ups aren’t telling the children. I’m sure she thought she was the last to know, not the first.”
anchor: Kimy and Clare and I all sigh audibly

fact: 最后一幕：Kimy 端出三杯紫红色饮料——「In honor of Alba's misadventures with beets」，Clare 补一句是「Sloe gin fizzes」；Kimy 举杯「Welcome to the family.」；Beck 觉得那紫色酒在舌上起泡，「For the first time in forever, I feel at home.」
quote: Soon Kimy emerges from the kitchen with three red-purple drinks on a tray—“In honor of Alba’s misadventures with beets,” Kimy says—“Sloe gin fizzes,” Clare adds. Kimy offers a toast: “Welcome to the family.” We click glasses. The purple liquor effervesces on my tongue. For the first time in forever, I feel at home.
anchor: I hear a cocktail shaker in action
